subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Across Cultures · Reading for Pleasure · Review and Reference
lesson: Across Cultures: Spain and Reading for Pleasure: the Shanghai Maglev Train
outcomes: Read about Spain and answer questions on its history and culture
Learn new words such as peninsula, cosmopolitan and cape
Read an article about the Shanghai Maglev train and find its main ideas

tf.s: General Francisco Franco ruled Spain after the Civil War.
tf.why: Yes, the text says Franco ruled after the Civil War.

tf.s: About 3.3 million people live in Madrid.
Don Quixote was written by General Franco.
tf.why: Don Quixote was written by Miguel de Cervantes.

tf.s: A matador carries a sword and a cape.
tf.why: Right, the cape and sword are part of his role.

tf.s: At La Tomatina, people throw squashy tomatoes.
tf.why: Yes, the festival is famous for throwing tomatoes.

tf.s: A Maglev train uses magnets to float above the track.
tf.why: Correct, that is what makes it special.

tf.s: A Maglev train is slower and noisier than ordinary trains.
tf.why: It is fast, smooth and quiet.
Squashy means soft and easy to press flat.

tf.s: A 'cosmopolitan' city has people from many different countries and cultures.
tf.why: Yes, cosmopolitan means international and varied.

tf.s: A 'peninsula' is land surrounded by water on all sides.
tf.why: A peninsula has water on most sides but is joined to the mainland.

boxes.why: Cervantes is the famous Spanish writer.

mcq.why: A matador carries a sword and a cape.

mcq.why: Don Quixote is the famous novel from the text.

mcq.q: A train travels very fast without touching the track. What kind of train is it?
Why is a Maglev train smooth and quiet?
o: it floats above the track, so there is little contact
mcq.why: Without wheels rubbing on rails, it is quiet.

mcq.q: How is a Maglev train different from an ordinary train?
o: it uses magnets to float instead of running on wheels
mcq.why: Floating on magnets is the key difference.

mcq.q: Why does the word 'squashy' suit the tomatoes at La Tomatina?
o: soft tomatoes break easily when thrown
mcq.why: Squashy means soft, so they burst when thrown.
